subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback contract, or should this PR be narrowed to the standard/canonical OpenTelemetry resource-identity path?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not just syntax: choosing the collector-visible instance identity source affects operator configuration, privacy, resource cardinality, and compatibility with the open canonical identity issue.

options.title: Use Standard Or Canonical Identity
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`, `serviceInstanceIdDetector`, or the stable identity source approved for the canonical issue.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` intentionally, but require docs, precedence rules, privacy notes, upgrade expectations, and final export proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it in favor of the canonical resource-identity issue if maintainers want the broader design settled first.

recommendation.title: Use Standard Or Canonical Identity
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`, `serviceInstanceIdDetector`, or the stable identity source approved for the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest recent diagnostics-otel history signal around the current resource block and adjacent exporter hardening.
